content.title: Simultaneous computation of multiple excited states via double bracket flows
content.abstract: Efficient computation of excited states is essential for studying strongly correlated many-body systems and molecular electronic structure. In this work, we propose a framework for simultaneously simulating multiple excited states based on dynamical flows. The main idea is to exploit a common double bracket flow that drives different pure initial states toward different target excited states without such prior information. We establish a necessary condition for convergence and a sufficient condition for exponential convergence. We further develop two scheduling strategies: Chebyshev scheduling
